about: the bound analog stick moves the wrestler (2026-11-20, controls): a singles match, both men on controllers (pad 1 Austin, pad 2 The Rock, who is never touched), CONTROL MODE 6-BUTTON (the stick moves him there: arcctl.c stick_dirs). Run with ctl_stick_pad's and ctl_stick_keys' controls_n64.json in the game folder: the N64 stick on the pads' LEFT stick (the left stick off the d-pad) and on the keys T G F H. Every 6 s: pad 1's left stick pushed left 1.5 s, then the key H (the stick right) 1.5 s -- Austin walks left, then right. The log's '[pads] ... in use' lines show the stick's rows; state.csv's s0_x / s0_z show the walks.

expect.name: nobody's position went bad
expect.check: finite(s0_x, s0_y, s0_z, s1_x, s1_y, s1_z)
